VALUE VALIDATED, ROUTE CORRECTED (RYA-819/831, ratified 2026-08-16). A(Fe I) = 7.466 stands on its agreement with Asplund, Amarsi & Grevesse 2021 (7.46, +0.006) and is UNCHANGED from v3/v4. What v4 asserted about HOW it was reached is withdrawn: the chain was stated as 1D-NLTE 7.516 minus a Magic-2013 1D→3D offset of 0.05, and that offset is NOT the 3D-atmosphere term. Measured per line against the Amarsi-2022 3D-NLTE MLP, A(3D-NLTE) − A(1D-NLTE) runs −0.013 to +0.018 dex by line sample — no part of that range contains −0.05 — and the correction is LINEAR IN EXCITATION POTENTIAL (+0.0287 per eV, corr 0.955, +0.143 dex across 5 eV), so NO tabulated scalar can represent it. The −0.05 landed the right answer by absorbing the RYA-161 ungraded-gf zero point, measured at +0.1013 dex. Same shape as the −0.127 RYA-817 found reverse-engineered from a target. SCALE UNCHANGED: 7.466 does sit on the 3D scale, so method_scale stays 3D-NLTE (Fe I); it was the ROUTE that was wrong, never the scale. STILL OWED (RYA-811, restated): this row declares its scale only via the legacy method_scale prose. scale_state/corrections_applied are NOT added here because corrections_applied=[] is a POSITIVE claim (RYA-674) that cannot be made truthfully for the other 25 elements without auditing each.
